rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making parts into a coherent whole, including combining components and integrating computer systems.

example.english: The company finally completed the integration of the two computer systems, making them much easier for staff to use.
example.traditional: 公司終於整合晒兩套電腦系統，員工用起上嚟方便好多。

rows.note: Use this specifically for the mathematical operation of finding an integral.

example.english: You need to do the integration of this function first before you can find the area.

rows.note: Use this specifically for people or minorities becoming part of a community or society.

example.english: The government should provide more support to promote the social integration of new immigrants.
